title: A second-order energy-stable sequential regularization scheme for the Navier-Stokes equations
summary: In this paper, we construct a second-order decoupled scheme for the Navier-Stokes equations based on the idea of the auxiliary variable and the sequential regularization method (SRM). The proposed scheme enjoys unconditional energy stability, which is generally unavailable for the existing SRM, while preserving its key advantage of avoiding artificial pressure boundary conditions and maintaining the original velocity boundary conditions.
